name: com.modernwestern.observer-vm
description:
Zero-allocation, strongly typed MVVM bindings for Unity UI (UGUI + TextMeshPro), inspired by Unreal's UMG.
Views derive from Widget<TViewModel>, ViewModels expose Observable<T> properties and Commands, and bindings are declared once with Bind.Text, Bind.Value, Bind.Click...

samples.description: Start here. A shop where every Buy button enables and disables itself with your gold: one Wallet ViewModel shared by many widgets, derived state (Command.CanExecute), and rows generated from data with a single prefab. Requires TextMeshPro (import TMP Essential Resources when prompted).

UI over a 3D world: nameplates that follow the characters on screen (health, mana, floating damage numbers), cards that pop up over objects when you come close, and a HUD that reacts to what you do in the world (chests, a healing shrine, enemies). Uses View Bindings, code bindings and child widgets together. Works with the Built-in pipeline and URP, and with the legacy Input Manager and the Input System package. Requires TextMeshPro (import TMP Essential Resources when prompted).

A ready-to-play scene: a player HUD (Widget prefab) bound to a PlayerViewModel with text, a health bar, a two-way volume slider and mute toggle, and Hit/Respawn commands. Works with the legacy Input Manager and the Input System package. Requires TextMeshPro (import TMP Essential Resources when prompted).
